changes.title: Demand per law office first published
changes.summary: Five public datasets joined by state: residents, bankruptcy cases, fatal crashes, divorces, Spanish speakers with limited English and eviction filings for each of the 177,138 private law offices in the 51 states, as ratios and thirds of states.
